name: @activepieces/piece-enrichlayer
description: Professional network data enrichment API — company profiles, person data, work emails, and more.

auth.description: You can obtain your API key from [Dashboard Settings](https://enrichlayer.com/dashboard/api-key/).

get_company_profile.name: get_company_profile
get_company_profile.description: Get structured data of a Company Profile from a professional network URL (1 credit)

url.description: Professional network company URL to enrich (e.g., https://www.linkedin.com/company/google/)

categories.description: Append category data for this company (+1 credit)

funding_data.description: Return a list of funding rounds (+1 credit)

extra.description: Enrich with Crunchbase ranking, contact info, social accounts, funding details, IPO status (+1 credit)

use_cache.description: Control how cached data is used

fallback_to_cache.description: Fallback behavior if fetching a fresh profile fails

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a full structured company profile from a known professional-network company URL; read-only and safe to retry. Use this when you already have the company's profile URL. If you only have a name or domain, call Look Up Company first to resolve the URL. Optional add-ons (funding, acquisitions, categories, extra Crunchbase data) cost extra credits.

get_person_profile.name: get_person_profile
get_person_profile.description: Get structured data of a Person Profile from a professional network URL (1 credit)

profile_url.description: Professional network profile URL (e.g., https://linkedin.com/in/johnrmarty/). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

twitter_profile_url.description: Twitter/X profile URL (e.g., https://x.com/johnrmarty/). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

facebook_profile_url.description: Facebook profile URL (e.g., https://facebook.com/johnrmarty/). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

extra.description: Enrich with gender, birth date, industry, and interests (+1 credit)

personal_contact_number.description: Enrich with personal numbers (+1 credit per number)

personal_email.description: Enrich with personal emails (+1 credit per email)

use_cache.description: Control how cached data is used

fallback_to_cache.description: Fallback behavior if fetching a fresh profile fails

live_fetch.description: Force a fresh profile fetch (+9 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a full structured person profile from a known professional-network, Twitter/X, or Facebook URL (supply exactly one); read-only and safe to retry. Use when you already have the profile URL. If you only have a name and company, call Look Up Person first to resolve the URL. Optional enrichments (contact numbers, personal emails, social IDs, Live Fetch) add credits.

get_school_profile.name: get_school_profile
get_school_profile.description: Get structured data of a School Profile from a professional network URL (1 credit)

url.description: Professional network school URL to enrich (e.g., https://www.linkedin.com/school/national-university-of-singapore)

use_cache.description: Control how cached data is used

live_fetch.description: Force a fresh profile fetch (+9 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Enrich a single school or university into structured profile data given its professional-network school URL. Pick this when you already have the school URL and need its details; read-only and idempotent. Use Live Fetch to force a fresh fetch instead of cached data at a higher credit cost.

get_company_lookup.name: get_company_lookup
get_company_lookup.description: Resolve a Company Profile from company name, domain, or location (2 credits)

company_name.description: Name of the company. Requires either Company Name or Company Domain.

company_domain.description: Company website or domain (e.g., accenture.com). Requires either Company Name or Company Domain.

company_location.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., sg, us)

enrich_profile.description: Enrich the result with cached company profile data (+1 credit)

aiMetadata.description: Resolve a single company's professional-network URL/profile from its name or domain (one of the two is required), optionally narrowed by country. Read-only and safe to retry. Use this as the entry point when you only know a company name or domain; to find many companies by attributes use Search Companies, and to enrich an already-known URL use Get Company Profile.

get_company_id_lookup.name: get_company_id_lookup
get_company_id_lookup.displayName: Look Up Company by Numeric ID
get_company_id_lookup.description: Resolve the vanity ID of a company from its numeric ID (0 credits)

id.description: The company's internal, immutable numeric ID (e.g., 1441 for Google)

aiMetadata.description: Resolve a company's vanity (public) identifier from its internal immutable numeric ID. Read-only, free, and safe to retry. Use only when you have the numeric company ID and need the vanity URL slug; to find a company by name or domain use Look Up Company instead.

get_person_lookup.name: get_person_lookup
get_person_lookup.description: Look up a person by name and company information (2 credits)

first_name.description: First name of the person (e.g., Bill)

last_name.description: Last name of the person (e.g., Gates)

title.description: Title the person holds at their current job (e.g., Co-chair)

location.description: Country, city, or state name (e.g., Seattle)

enrich_profile.description: Enrich the result with cached profile data (+1 credit)

similarity_checks.description: Perform similarity checks to eliminate false positives. Credits are deducted even if null is returned.

aiMetadata.description: Resolve a single person's professional-network profile from their first name plus a company name or domain (both required), optionally refined by last name, title, or location. Read-only and safe to retry. Use this as the entry point when you have a name and employer but no profile URL; once you have the URL use Get Person Profile to enrich. Similarity checks consume credits even when no match is found.

get_role_lookup.name: get_role_lookup
get_role_lookup.description: Find the person who most closely matches a specified role at a company (3 credits)

role.description: Role to look up (e.g., ceo, cto, vp of engineering)

enrich_profile.description: Enrich the result with cached profile data (+1 credit)

aiMetadata.description: Find the single person who best matches a given role (e.g. "ceo", "vp of engineering") at a named company. Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you need the one person holding a role; to get many people by job-title keyword use Search Company Employees. Profile enrichment adds a credit.

get_employee_listing.name: get_employee_listing
get_employee_listing.description: Get a list of employees of a company (3 credits per employee returned)

employment_status.description: Filter by current, past, or all employees

enrich_profiles.description: Return full profiles instead of just URLs (+1 credit each)

boolean_role_search.description: Filter employees by title using boolean expression (e.g., "founder" OR "co-founder"). Base cost: 10 credits + 3 per match.

role_search.description: Filter employees by title using regex. Prefer Boolean Role Search instead.

country.description: Filter by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g., us). +3 credits per result.

sort_by.description: Sort employees (+50 credits base + 10 per employee returned)

coy_name_match.description: Include profiles that match the company name in addition to URL

resolve_numeric_id.description: Enable support for company URLs with numerical IDs (+2 credits)

use_cache.description: Control how cached data is used

aiMetadata.description: List a company's employees from its professional-network URL, filterable by employment status (current/past/all), country, and sortable by tenure. Read-only and safe to retry. Use this for a broad roster; to target a specific job title use Search Company Employees, and for just a head count use Get Employee Count. Boolean role filtering, sorting, and profile enrichment add credits.

get_employee_count.name: get_employee_count
get_employee_count.description: Get the total number of employees of a company (1 credit)

employment_status.description: Count current, past, or all employees

coy_name_match.description: Include profiles that match the company name in addition to URL

estimated_employee_count.description: Include estimated employee count from the company profile (+1 credit)

at_date.description: Get employee count at a specific date (YYYY-MM-DD format). +1-5 credits.

use_cache.description: Control how cached data is used

aiMetadata.description: Return only the total employee head count for a company from its professional-network URL, with optional current/past/all status and an as-of date. Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you need a size metric, not the people; to retrieve the actual employee roster use List Company Employees. Estimated-count and historical date options add credits.

get_employee_search.name: get_employee_search
get_employee_search.description: Search employees of a company by job title using boolean or regex keywords (10 credits base + 3 per match)

keyword_boolean.description: Job title keyword in boolean search syntax (e.g., "ceo OR cto"). Max 255 characters. Takes precedence over regex.

keyword_regex.description: Job title keyword in regex format (e.g., ceo|cto). Prefer Boolean keyword instead.

country.description: Filter by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., us). +3 credits per result.

enrich_profiles.description: Return full profiles instead of just URLs (+1 credit each)

resolve_numeric_id.description: Enable support for company URLs with numerical IDs (+2 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Find employees of a company whose job title matches a boolean (or legacy regex) keyword, given the company URL. Read-only and safe to retry. Use this when you need people in specific roles (e.g. "ceo OR cto"); to list all employees without a title filter use List Company Employees. Carries a base cost plus per-match credits, and country filtering or profile enrichment add more.

get_student_listing.name: get_student_listing
get_student_listing.description: Get a list of students at a school (3 credits per student returned)

student_status.description: Filter by current, past, or all students

enrich_profiles.description: Return full profiles instead of just URLs (+1 credit each)

boolean_search_keyword.description: Filter students by major using boolean expression (e.g., "computer OR cs"). Base: 10 credits + 6 per student.

country.description: Filter by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g., us). +3 credits per result.

sort_by.description: Sort students (+50 credits base + 10 per student returned)

resolve_numeric_id.description: Enable support for school URLs with numerical IDs (+2 credits)

aiMetadata.description: List students/alumni of a school from its professional-network school URL, filterable by status (current/past/all), major (boolean keyword), and country, and sortable by matriculation or graduation. Read-only and safe to retry. Use for school rosters; the company equivalent is List Company Employees. Boolean major search, sorting, and profile enrichment add credits.

get_work_email_lookup.name: get_work_email_lookup
get_work_email_lookup.description: Get the work email address for a professional network profile. 95%+ deliverability guarantee (3 credits)

callback_url.description: Webhook URL to notify when the request finishes processing (optional)

aiMetadata.description: Find a person's work (business) email address from their professional-network profile URL, with a 95%+ deliverability guarantee. Read-only and safe to retry. Use for B2B/work contact; for personal emails use Look Up Personal Email, and to go from an email back to profiles use Reverse Email Lookup. Processing may be asynchronous, so an optional callback URL can be supplied for completion notification.

get_reverse_email_lookup.name: get_reverse_email_lookup
get_reverse_email_lookup.description: Find social media profiles from an email address. Works with both personal and work emails (3 credits)

email.description: Email address to look up (e.g., johndoe@enrichlayer.com)

lookup_depth.description: Superficial: no credits if no results. Deep: credits used regardless.

enrich_profile.description: Enrich the result with cached profile data (+1 credit)

aiMetadata.description: Find social/professional-network profiles associated with an email address (personal or work). Read-only and safe to retry. Use to go from a known email back to a person's profiles; the reverse direction (profile to emails) is Look Up Personal Email or Look Up Work Email. Superficial lookup depth charges no credits when there are no results; Deep charges regardless.

get_reverse_phone_lookup.name: get_reverse_phone_lookup
get_reverse_phone_lookup.description: Find social media profiles from a phone number (3 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Look up the social media profiles associated with a phone number supplied in E.164 format. Pick this when a phone number is your only identifier and you want to resolve it to people/profiles; read-only and idempotent, billed per call.

get_personal_contact.name: get_personal_contact
get_personal_contact.description: Find personal phone numbers from a social media profile (1 credit per number returned)

profile_url.description: Professional network profile URL. Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

twitter_profile_url.description: Twitter/X profile URL (e.g., https://x.com/enrichlayer). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

facebook_profile_url.description: Facebook profile URL (e.g., https://www.facebook.com/zuck). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

page_size.description: Maximum numbers returned (0 = no limit, default: 0)

aiMetadata.description: Find a person's personal phone numbers from one social profile URL (professional-network, Twitter/X, or Facebook — supply exactly one). Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you have a profile link and need phone contact details; the email counterpart is Look Up Personal Email.

get_personal_email.name: get_personal_email
get_personal_email.description: Find personal email addresses from a social media profile (1 credit per email returned)

profile_url.description: Professional network profile URL. Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

twitter_profile_url.description: Twitter/X profile URL (e.g., https://x.com/enrichlayer). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

facebook_profile_url.description: Facebook profile URL (e.g., https://www.facebook.com/zuck). Provide only one of Profile URL, Twitter URL, or Facebook URL.

email_validation.description: How to validate each email found

page_size.description: Maximum emails returned (0 = no limit, default: 0)

aiMetadata.description: Find a person's personal (non-work) email addresses given one social profile URL (professional-network, Twitter/X, or Facebook — supply exactly one). Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you have a profile link and need personal contact emails; for work emails use Look Up Work Email, and to go from email back to profiles use Reverse Email Lookup.

get_disposable_email_check.name: get_disposable_email_check
get_disposable_email_check.description: Check if an email address belongs to a disposable email service (0 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Check whether an email address belongs to a disposable/temporary email provider. Read-only, free, and safe to retry. Use to validate or filter sign-up and lead emails before further enrichment; this only flags disposability and does not return profile data.

get_company_picture.name: get_company_picture
get_company_picture.description: Get the profile picture URL of a company from cached profiles (0 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a company's profile picture URL from its professional-network company page URL. Pick this when you only need the logo/avatar image link and not the full company record; it reads from cached profiles, costs no credits, and is read-only and idempotent.

get_person_picture.name: get_person_picture
get_person_picture.description: Get the profile picture URL of a person from cached profiles (0 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Return the profile picture URL for a person from a known professional-network profile URL, served from cached profiles. Read-only, free, and safe to retry. Use only when you need the avatar image link; for full profile data use Get Person Profile.

get_job_profile.name: get_job_profile
get_job_profile.description: Get structured data of a job posting (2 credits)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve full structured data for a single job posting from its professional-network job URL. Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you have a specific job URL; to discover job postings for a company use Search Company Jobs first.

get_job_search.name: get_job_search
get_job_search.description: List jobs posted by a company with optional filters (2 credits)

search_id.description: The search_id of the company (from Company Profile API)

when.description: Filter by when the job was posted

aiMetadata.description: List job postings from a company, filterable by keyword, job type, experience level, recency, and work flexibility. Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you need the actual job listings; to get only the matching count without the listings use Get Job Count. Requires the company search_id obtained from a company profile lookup.

get_job_count.name: get_job_count
get_job_count.description: Count the number of jobs posted by a company (2 credits)

search_id.description: The search_id of the company (from Company Profile API)

when.description: Filter by when the job was posted

aiMetadata.description: Return only the number of job postings from a company matching optional filters (keyword, job type, experience level, recency, flexibility), not the listings themselves. Read-only and safe to retry. Use when you need a hiring-volume metric; to retrieve the actual postings use Search Company Jobs. Requires the company search_id from a company profile lookup.
